area.description: Output size tier used with aspect_ratio; defaults to 4K.

aspect_ratio.description: "auto" or "X:Y" with integers 1-300 between 1:3 and 3:1, for example 16:9. Use with optional area.

n.description: Number of images for this request; defaults to 1. Each delivered image is charged once.

output_file.description: Optional downloaded base filename. Directory components are ignored.

output_format.description: Defaults to jpeg. jpg is the same as jpeg.

prompt.description: Image description. With reference_images, refer to them as 图1, 图2, ... in the order given.

reference_images.description: Optional 1-16 reference images to edit or combine. JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC or HEIF; each at most 64 MB, 128-8192 px per side, aspect ratio at most 4:1.

url.description: temp_url from a completed upload_temp_url upload (upload local files first), or an existing upload URL from this environment.
